items.difficulty_reason: The lemma records the form of the theorem on formal functions over a complete Noetherian base ring, where the completion of the cohomology modules on the left hand side is redundant (statement lines 4480-4490). The proof invokes the general theorem, uses the finiteness of the cohomology of a coherent sheaf on a proper space over a Noetherian affine base to know that the modules are already complete, and thereby identifies the limit description with the cohomology itself. The comparison between completion and the finite module is the substance, so the claim is H2.
